title: I recently learned that waste heat will boil the oceans in about 400 years.
summary: Sabine Hossenfelder explains that waste heat from ever-growing energy use could eventually boil the oceans in a few centuries, whatever the energy source. She discusses proposed ways to cool the planet.
why: HN cites it in energy debates as an illustration of the long-term thermal limits of exponential energy consumption growth.

quote.text: You might enjoy Sabine Hossenfelder's video exploring this
